frozen_before: any frame of these tests was downloaded or opened; no outcome of these tests exists in the project (no NASA series, no test sheet)
purpose: blind diameter series for scoring a frozen n-heptane candidate against the adopted release
rule:
(from RESULTS_HEPTANE_D3.md section 6, re-derived here from the raw text files):
  * PSI-68 (FLEX-2) day 2013-03-28: E087C01-C04, C06-C09, n-heptane (PSI data record "Heptane"),
    settings: no fibre, no flow; no gas reading that day (ambient carried, see AMBIENT_E087);
  * PSI-69 (FLEX) points of 2013 named C<day>H<nn>: days 021, 030, 039, 049 (23 points). Configuration
    from each test's MDCA settings (TP_PARAMETER_FIBER_USAGE_FLAG); ambient from the gas-reading points
    C<day>R01 (`_Mixture.txt`) of the same and neighbouring days; pressure from the chamber readings.
  * Fibre-supported points (settings flag Yes: 7 of the 23) are listed but NOT in the measured batch:
    configuration, decided before any frame (the heptane releases are free-droplet models).

method.tool_frozen_by: runs/dev/media/droplet/FREEZE.json (same sha256; validated against NASA's processed diameters on six FLEX train tests; used unchanged, never edited)
method.invocation: droplet_diameter.run(<staged dir>, investigation='FLEX', fov_mm=30.25, sheet_dir=...) via tools/wsp/media/heptane_fresh_measure.py

pixel_scale.rule: field of view 30.25 mm over the image width in pixels, passed explicitly (fov_mm=30.25); 33.85 px/mm on a 1024 px image, 16.93 on a 512 px binned image
pixel_scale.source: FLEX HiBMs documented field of view 30.25 mm (TP15 section 3.1.2), verified against NASA's processed diameters on six FLEX train tests (PILOT_REPORT.md); for FLEX-2 the requirements document FLX-REQ-0001 4.1.56/4.1.57 (droplet view 3.0 cm, 30 um per pixel) and the needle-arm width (53.9 px on 47 FLEX-2 tests, 54.4 px on FLEX) (runs/dev/media/droplet/SCALE_FLEX2.md). The 2013 PSI-69 points use the same MDCA/CIR hardware between FLEX-2 days. Not set from any droplet size, rate or expected diameter.
pixel_scale.uncertainty: 1.5 % (1 sigma) on the scale; worst case -7 % (SCALE_FLEX2.md section 3)
pixel_scale.check: the tool's needle-arm ruler_check is recorded per test; it is a check, never used to rescale

time_origin.rule: time_s = camera stamp - timeline 'AS Igniter Off/Retract Start' (as in FREEZE.json time_origin: NASA's processed FLEX t = 0 sits -0.31 to +0.41 s from it)

acceptance.rule: FREEZE.json acceptance, unchanged: clock check within 0.3 s, >= 30 usable (ok, soot) frames after deployment + 0.1 s, coverage >= 0.6 of the measured span
acceptance.screens: as flex2_batch_summary.py: 'failed' if the tool saw no droplet in > 95 % of post-deployment frames; flex2_truncation_screen.py truncated or hijacked track; a visual check of the contact sheets by the measurer (fibre or needle seen, track on another object, droplet out of view) can only fail a series, never pass one the rule refused
acceptance.exclusions: by measurement quality only, written with their reason; never by any model output

method.output: runs/dev/heptane_fresh/series/<test>.json: liquid_diameter observations in m on the stated time base, per-frame tool flags, conditions as frozen here, quality and reasons
